components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button for booking, search, payment, approval, and profile completion.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary, #004271); color: #fff; padding: 12px 20px; font: 700 14px/1.35 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-container, #0d5a94); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-fixed, #d1e4ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action for details, back links, messaging, and non-primary choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--primary, #004271); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: var(--primary, #004271); padding: 12px 20px; font: 700 14px/1.35 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--surface-container-high, #dee8ff); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary-fixed, #d1e4ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Default form field for auth, filters, onboarding, admin review, and wallet forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; color: var(--on-surface, #111c2d); } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #414750); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c1c7d1); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: var(--on-surface, #111c2d); padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--outline, #717781); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--primary, #004271); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,66,113,.2); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Default white product container for dashboard panels, forms, profile sections, and admin review blocks.
components.html:
Panel title

Operational copy and data live here.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c1c7d1); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--on-surface, #111c2d); padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #414750); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact semantic status label for tutor verification, documents, payment, and booking states.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font: 700 12px/1.2 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-success { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tertiary-fixed, #6ffbbe) 30%, white); color: var(--tertiary, #004a31); } .ds-chip-warning { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--secondary-container, #fea619) 25%, white); color: var(--secondary, #855300); } .ds-chip-error { background: var(--error-container, #ffdad6); color: var(--error, #ba1a1a); } .ds-chip-neutral { background: var(--surface-container-high, #dee8ff); color: var(--on-surface-variant, #414750); }

components.name: Dashboard Navigation Item
components.description: Sidebar and mobile navigation item with primary-filled active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #414750); font: 700 14px/1.35 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface-container-high, #dee8ff); color: var(--primary, #004271); transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--primary, #004271); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-nav-item-active:hover { background: var(--primary, #004271); color: #fff; transform: none; }

components.css: .ds-empty { border: 1px dashed var(--outline-variant, #c1c7d1); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; padding: 32px; text-align: center; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; color: var(--on-surface, #111c2d); } .ds-empty h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-empty p { margin: 8px auto 0; max-width: 420px; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #414750); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-empty button { margin-top: 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary, #004271); color: #fff; padding: 12px 20px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-empty button:hover { background: var(--primary-container, #0d5a94); }

narrative.overview:
TutorConnect currently uses a restrained product system: cool near-white surfaces, deep blue primary actions, amber payment emphasis, green verification success, and red error states. The system is built for task flow clarity across public discovery, student dashboards, tutor onboarding, wallet actions, payment receipts, and admin review queues.

The visual language is familiar and operational. Rounded white panels, thin blue-gray borders, compact labels, Material Symbols icons, and light shadows make the app feel calm and practical. The current system is not a redesign target yet; document it as a reliable baseline, then standardize the gaps before adding more expression.

The system explicitly rejects gimmicky edtech visuals, childish illustrations, generic SaaS gradients, vague marketing language, decorative dashboards, excessive animation, and hidden booking or payment states.
keyCharacteristics: Cool blue-tinted product surfaces (#f9f9ff, #f0f3ff, #e7eeff) with white cards.
Deep primary blue (#004271) for navigation, current state, primary actions, and key headings.
Amber (#fea619, #855300) for payments, warnings, and commercial emphasis.
Green (#004a31, #006444, #6ffbbe) for verified, approved, completed, and successful states.
Dense but readable product layouts: side navigation, sticky headers, card grids, filters, tables, and status panels.

rules.name: The Trust Blue Rule
rules.body: Primary blue is the action and orientation color. Do not use it as free decoration.

rules.name: The Status Color Rule
rules.body: Amber means payment, warning, pending, or commercial emphasis; green means verified, approved, completed, or successful; red means error, rejection, cancellation, or destructive action.

rules.name: The Token Gap Rule
rules.body: Several screens reference colors that are not defined in globals.css (`--surface-bright`, `--surface-variant`, `--secondary-fixed`, `--secondary-fixed-dim`, `--tertiary-fixed-dim`, `--on-primary-container`, `--on-secondary-container`). Standardize these before expanding the system.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Keep Be Vietnam Pro as the only UI family unless a future brand refresh deliberately introduces a second display family.

rules.name: The Density Rule
rules.body: Product pages use compact 14px labels and body text; public hero pages may use larger headings, but authenticated surfaces should stay fixed-scale and task-first.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Use tonal background and 1px borders before adding stronger shadows.

rules.name: The Shadow Restraint Rule
rules.body: Shadows should mark hierarchy, hover, or floating controls. Avoid decorative glass panels except where they already exist and are intentionally being preserved.

dos: Do keep the existing cool surface ramp as the default product atmosphere: #f9f9ff, #f0f3ff, #e7eeff, #dee8ff, and white panels.
Do use #004271 for primary actions, selected navigation, progress, and orientation.
Do use status color semantically: amber for payment/pending, green for verified/success, red for rejected/error.
Do preserve the single-family Be Vietnam Pro typography system for Vietnamese readability.
Do document booking, payment, verification, cancellation, withdrawal, and admin decision states explicitly in UI copy.
Do standardize undefined CSS variables before creating new screens.
Do keep cards, forms, and tables product-dense, with visible labels and direct next actions.
donts: Don't redesign the app from this file. This document captures the current system and names what should be standardized later.
Don't use gimmicky edtech visuals, childish illustrations, generic SaaS gradients, vague marketing language, decorative dashboards, excessive animation, or overly playful interaction patterns.
Don't hide booking terms, pricing, tutor verification, cancellation policy, payment status, or admin decision history behind vague labels.
Don't introduce LMS, video-platform, or AI-first visual patterns into the MVP marketplace loop.
Don't add gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, side-stripe card accents, or repeated hero-metric templates.
Don't create new button, input, badge, or card vocabularies without first standardizing the existing rounded-lg/rounded-xl product primitives.
